sections.title: Booking and order documents
sections.content:
This menu collects the documents of bookings and orders. By default the documents are grouped by booking or order.

![](/uploads/25277af243bce7302309e291.png)

You can use the "No document" filter to list the entries that have no file attached yet:

![](/uploads/37d4a7ebf5a6d27f5b8a798c.png)

sections.title: Container and waybill documents
sections.content:
This menu collects the documents of containers and waybills — the documents drivers collect and attach when they complete a task in the mobile app. By default the documents are grouped by container or waybill.

![](/uploads/328a65bf7e449022bced258b.png)

You can use the "No document" filter to list the entries that have no file attached yet:

![](/uploads/5642a7e95f15300ce07e4810.png)

**Note:** Container and waybill documents are kept in the system for one year only. After one year the files and images are deleted.
